headline: Clean little prime-angle windswell at dawn, gone junky by afternoon.
today: Prime SSE angle but small at 1.8ft and short period. Dawn and morning are near-glassy with light NW/WSW, so grab the early window before the S onshore ramps up in the afternoon. Log it and don't overthink the board.

daysToWatch.note: Light SE dawn and a prime angle with a touch more period — clean but tiny. A dawn log session at best.
